text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam Hussein receives Sudanese envoy.
- Iraq exports 10.1 million barrels of oil through Mina al- Bakr terminal in the Gulf since last month's implementation of the oil-for-food deal signed with the U.N..
- Iraq and the Philippines sign a parliamentary cooperation agreement.
- Deputy premier Tareq Aziz meets former French army chief- of-staff Jeannou Lacaze.
- A team of U.N. experts visit Saddam river to assess its effectiveness in fighting desertification.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
